item.title: Southern's 'Human Jukebox' given key to the city after winning ESPN's Band of the Year
item.description: BATON ROUGE - Southern University's marching band, the Human Jukebox, received a key to the city from Mayor-President Sid Edwards after the band won ESPN's Band of the Year competition.Two Division I schools, Southern's Human Jukebox and Florida A&M's Marching 100 were selected to compete; there were also two Division II bands, Miles College's Purple Marching Machine and Fayetteville State University's Marching Bronco Xpress. item.title: City installs 'Red Stick' downtown as local version of New Year's Eve ball
item.description: BATON ROUGE &mdash; City leaders have begun preparing for New Year's Eve as crews installed the "Red Stick" in downtown Baton Rouge.The local version of the famous New Year's Eve Ball in New York was erected at the North Boulevard Town Square near City Hall.&nbsp;The "Red Stick" will be dropped at midnight on New Year's Eve to conclude the city's Red Stick Revelry Celebration, which will begin at 8 p.m.Permalink| Comments

item.title: Baldwin Police searching for man wanted for nonconsensual disclosure of private images
item.description: BALDWIN - The Baldwin Police Department is seeking the public's assistance in locating a man wanted for nonconsensual disclosure of private images.Officials are looking for Paul Vernon Trahan, 36, last seen in Lafayette, Louisiana.Anyone with information regarding his current whereabouts is asked to contact the Baldwin Police Department at 337-923-4845.Permalink| Comments

item.title: Report: LSU interim head coach Frank Wilson hired at Ole Miss to be running backs coach
item.description: BATON ROUGE - LSU interim head coach and running backs coach Frank Wilson is heading to Ole Miss as their running backs coach, according to On3 Sports.Wilson served as LSU's interim head coach after the firing of Brian Kelly; he served as the assistant head coach and running backs coach from the 2022 season to 2025. item.title: First memorial marker for 1927 Great Flood centennial put in place at Pointe Coupee museum
item.description: NEW ROADS - At the Pointe Coupee Museum, history was made today as the Great Flood centennial put their first memorial marker in place.The marker commemorates the impact that the 1927 Mississippi River flood had on the parish. The base of the marker is a compass that provides historical facts about major events during or as a result of the flood.Permalink| Comments

item.title: Federal judge rules Louisiana law on age verification on social media is unconstitutional
item.description: BATON ROUGE - A federal judge blocked Louisiana from enforcing a law that would require age verification and parental consent on social media due to it being a violation of the First Amendment.Judge John deGravelles ruled in favor of NetChoice, a trade application for social media companies like Nextdoor, Pinterest, Snapchat and Meta, regarding the enforcement of The Secure Online Child Interaction and Age Limitation Act; he also granted a permanent injunction.
